description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberDao class, which manages database interactions related to email subscribers and email notifications within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting email subscriber data, as well as fetching email subscription details.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing email subscriber entities and related email notifications in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribersByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmailSubscriber entities associated with a specific email subscription ID, applying pagination and filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberByEmailSubscriptionIdPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for iterating through email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberListCountByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts the number of email subscribers linked to a specific email subscription ID.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches an EmailNotification entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Persists a given EmailSubscriber entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmailSubscriber by its ID and associated subscription ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmailSubscriberIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing email subscriber IDs from a given list, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: deleteEmailSubscribersByIds
methods.description: Deletes email subscribers based on provided list of IDs.
